# distinct_parentheses

<!-- Generated by xtask. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Summary:** Disallows DISTINCT used like a function call.

**Default level:** `warn`

**Fixable:** yes

## Rationale

DISTINCT applies to the whole select list, so parentheses around the first item are misleading.

## Configuration

```toml
[lints]
distinct_parentheses = { level = "warn" }
```

### Options

No options.

## Examples

**Anti-pattern:**

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT(a), b FROM foo
```

**Best practice:**

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT a, b FROM foo
```
